label: 4MP AcuSense fixed dome IP camera
description: 4 MP AcuSense dome with 120 dB WDR and human/vehicle classification, one RJ45 10/100 port. PoE 802.3af Class 3, max 6.5 W; also accepts 12 VDC.
notes: PoE class 802.3af Class 3, 12.95 W reserved at the switch, 6.5 W drawn. Wired only. Has a 12 VDC barrel jack as an alternative, so it can be powered without a PoE switch.
